repos_data.description: Open-source MCP server for Docweave — generate_pdf + read_pdf tools for AI agents (Claude, Cursor, …).
Open-source MCP server bridge for PDF Content Search — full-text PDF search + OCR for Claude/Cursor across thousands of documents.
MCP server for BulkRender — generate DOCX and PDF documents from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible AI assistant
MCP server for Claude Code — Apple Vision OCR & image analysis, fully offline, no API keys
MCP server for ChangeThisFile — free file conversion between 690+ formats (image, video, audio, document, data, font, ebook, archive). No auth required.

MCP server that gives AI clients structured, searchable access to a local folder of resume files (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT), exposing tools for querying resumes, work experiences, achievements, skills, side projects, and education.
MCP server for markdown — search, extract sections, list headings, find code blocks

PDF extraction that audits its own output — and certifies any other extractor's, catching pages they silently dropped. Verify signed manifests offline: free, MIT, no account. 0.903 on opendataloader-bench, #2 of 8 engines. 7-tool MCP server.
MCP server client examples for EasyAccessPDF — PDF accessibility (PDF/UA, WCAG) checks, auto-fix and document conversion from AI clients. Docs in EN/DE/FR/ES/JA.
Official Talonic MCP server. Lets AI agents extract structured data from any document via the Model Context Protocol.
MCP server with 40 tools for AI agents. Memory, web fetch, search, file ops, screenshots, and multi-agent coordination in one Go binary.

repo_meta_data.description: 📄🐹⚡ Go MCP server for multi-format document access — PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, CSV, images. Install and Go.
